bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
names="$(docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -Ei '(^|[-_])gaybbs([-_]|$)' || true)"
test "$(printf '%s\n' "$names" | sed '/^$/d' | wc -l)" -eq 1 || { echo STK04_LIVE_OWNER_AMBIGUOUS; exit 41; }
name="$names"
docker exec "$name" node -e 'const e=process.env; console.log("LIVE_GAYBBS_TOKEN_ENV="+(!!e.BOT_TOKEN));console.log("LIVE_GAYBBS_TOKEN_FILE_ENV="+(!!e.BOT_TOKEN_FILE));console.log("LIVE_GAYBBS_DATABASE_URL_ENV="+(!!e.DATABASE_URL));console.log("LIVE_GAYBBS_PGHOST_ENV="+(!!e.PGHOST));console.log("LIVE_GAYBBS_NODE_VERSION="+process.versions.node);'
docker exec "$name" sh -c 'for p in /app/gaybbs.mjs /app/sticker-topic-pin.mjs /run/secrets; do if test -e "$p"; then echo "LIVE_GAYBBS_PATH_PRESENT=$(basename "$p")"; fi; done'
echo STK04_LIVE_CONTAINER_ENV_READBACK_COMPLETE
